text:
Asha (CS): Quick onboarding sync for ChromaCare — they submitted the vendor risk form and asked specifically about embeddings retention + SOC2 scope. We need answers this week to avoid a potential renewal risk flagged by their procurement team.

Nora (ChromaCare): Thanks — can you enumerate what data we persist and where? Their legal wants retention windows for embeddings and logs.

Ryan (Solutions Eng): Short answer: embeddings persisted in our vector store for 30 days by default. We can extend to 90 days via an addendum and a config flag on Dedicated. Logs (request/response metadata) are kept 90 days for hosted; can be restricted on Private.

Asha (CS): @Ryan can you drop the exact config option and a one-liner I can paste into the vendor form?

Ryan (Solutions Eng): Paste this: `embeddings.retention_days = 30 (default); can be set to 90 with contract addendum)`. Also note: PII should be hashed client-side if required.

Sam (Security): Need to confirm SOC2 scope: do we process customer PII in non-prod? For ChromaCare they said devs might replay prod logs in staging.

Ryan (Solutions Eng): We don't copy prod PII into non-prod by default — there is a documented masking pipeline. If customer requests prod-to-nonprod replay we require an exception and additional safeguards (KMS, limited access).

Nora (ChromaCare): ChromaCare asks: will setting retention to 30 days impact embedding lookup performance or cost?

Ryan (Solutions Eng): No impact on lookup latency. Cost: small lower storage cost, marginal. I'll add a line to the form: `No change to inference latency; storage cost reduced proportional to retention.`

Asha (CS): Uploading the updated answers to the vendor form now. Also flagging a renewal risk: procurement said if we don't return final signed DPA + retention addendum by 2024-11-10 they may delay RFP.

Nora (ChromaCare): Ok noted. Can we schedule a 30-min ENABLE session for their SRE next Tue? They want runbook + alerting walkthrough.

Asha (CS): I can do Tue 10am PT. @infra-bot can you create a calendar invite and attach the onboarding runbook?

infra-bot: Created invite: Onboarding enablement — ChromaCare (2024-11-05 10:00 PT). Runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/runbooks/chromacare-onboard.pdf

Sam (Security): One more ask: please confirm key management for embeddings (BYOK supported on Private). I'll add that to the vendor form.

Ryan (Solutions Eng): Confirmed: BYOK supported on Private and Dedicated with customer KMS; hosted uses managed keys.

Nora (ChromaCare): This is great, thanks. If we get the signed addendum we'll proceed with Dedicated trial.

Asha (CS): Great — I'll follow up after the enablement call and update the renewal risk tracker. Flagging follow-up tasks: update vendor form (done), schedule enablement (done), security BYOK note (done). :white_check_mark: 

Nora (ChromaCare): :thumbsup:

Ryan (Solutions Eng): FYI, adding a short code snippet they can use to request retention change via API:
```
POST /v1/customers/{id}/settings
{ "embeddings": { "retention_days": 90 } }
```

Asha (CS): Perfect — I'll paste that into the technical appendix of the vendor form. Closing thread after call notes.
